Title: Multimaster support with Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Now available in private preview, Azure Cosmos DB offers multimaster support at global scale together with low latency and high availability, tunable consistency models, and comprehensive and flexible conflict resolution support (custom, LWW, CRDTs).

Learn more.
